label: John de Brebeuf, Isaac Jogues and Companions (SS. IOANNIS DE BREBEUF ET ISAAC JOGUES, PRESBYTERORUM, ET SOCIORUM, MARTYRUM, Die 19 octobris)

chants.notes: Printed with a book ellipsis 'Confitemini... et invocate' - not repaired; the gr_index_entry incipit for target p340 carries no ellipsis ('Confitemini et invocate').

Target page 468's gr_index_entry incipit carries a curated parenthetical '(sine alleluia)' not printed on this citing page; p468 also holds a second offertorium 'Iustorum animae' (gregobase 835, same mode) cited by other days - this one must resolve to gregobase 786.
